content_of_post_to_answer: Do you find that a room feels more focused when the chairs are all facing the same direction?
answer: There is something deeper happening than just visual order. Chairs facing the same direction subtly tell our brains that attention has a shared destination, which reduces the small decisions we make about where to look or how to position ourselves. But the same effect can also limit interaction: a room designed for focus is not always a room designed for conversation. The arrangement of a space quietly defines whether people are there to align, listen, create, or connect.
